newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone resumes rise on upgrades, results.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone resumes rise on upgrades, results.

text.p: Shares in Vodafone Group Plc resumed their advance on Thursday on follow through buying on a couple of broker upgrades following a strong set of results from the company, dealers said.
By 1238 GMT, the shares were up 7p to 289-1/2, the highest level in 2-1/2 months, in a generally firm telecommunications sector.
Vodafone shares were among the most actively traded shares in London, with 7.7 million shares registered.
Morgan Stanley and Lehman Brothers on Wednesday recommended the stock after the group earlier this week posted a 13 percent increase in annual profits.
